mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, a fresh upper-tail onset in dispersion of sixteen completed half-hour realized variances means volatility is arriving in clustered intraday waves rather than one isolated minute or a uniform high-noise regime. Follow the completed eight-hour displacement for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVACR measures lag-one dependence of absolute minute returns; HVRQC measures concentration in individual fourth-power shocks; FHVAR compares only two fixed two-hour halves; DVBCR measures daily backloading. HVIVDR measures scale-free cross-subwindow dispersion of sixteen nonoverlapping half-hour realized variances and reuses no event/control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: both total variation and subwindow variance dispersion must enter independent causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily variance-dispersion onsets are absent from Gross9

features.subwindow_variance: sum squared minute returns in each of sixteen fixed consecutive 30-minute subwindows
features.total_variation: sum of all sixteen subwindow variances, finite strict positive
features.variance_dispersion: coefficient of variation: population standard deviation of sixteen subwindow variances divided by their strict-positive mean
features.dispersion_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.variation_rank: same 270/180 strict-prior midrank for total_variation; rank>=0.65
features.completed_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent scale-free dispersion across sixteen fixed realized-variance subwindows

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no subwindow, dispersion, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
